mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE handle_status = 1) AS pending, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_DATE) AS today, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_DATE - 6) AS last7, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 1) AS type1, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 2) AS type2, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 3) AS type3, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 4) AS type4 FROM tenant_security_event

SELECT to_char(event_time::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS events FROM tenant_security_event WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1) GROUP BY event_time::date ORDER BY event_time::date
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_security_event SET handle_status = #{status}, handle_remark = #{remark}, handler_name = #{handler}, handle_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
